name: postiz
description: Postiz CLI - Command line interface for the Postiz social media scheduling API

scripts.prepublish-check: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const v=require('./package.json').version;const list=JSON.parse(execSync('npm view postiz versions --json',{encoding:'utf8'}));const cmp=(a,b)=>{const x=a.split('.').map(Number),y=b.split('.').map(Number);for(let i=0;i<3;i++){if(x[i]!==y[i])return x[i]-y[i]}return 0};const max=list.reduce((m,c)=>cmp(c,m)>0?c:m);if(cmp(v,max)<=0){console.error('Refusing to publish '+v+': must be greater than the highest published version '+max);process.exit(1)}console.log('Version '+v+' > '+max+' — ok to publish')"
scripts.publish: pnpm run prepublish-check && tsup && pnpm publish --access public --no-git-checks
